science_question: Do public CASDA and CSIRO DAP Parkes Pulsar Data Archive metadata actually document authenticated on-target native spectra or scan footprints at previously frozen OSIRIS directions?

background.R2C2: ATNF ATOA Parkes-only search completed for 5 fixed sources; 90 rows within 1.5 deg but all s_fov/s_region missing; no measured beam or on-target spectrum established.
background.baseline: No causal origin or non-detection can be drawn from an unobserved direction.

archive_routes.purpose: ASKAP science-ready image/spectral cube products and possible migrated Parkes spectra; imaging footprint distinct from native high-resolution SETI waterfall
Parkes pulsar high-time-resolution raw observations, not presumed continuous SETI high-spectral-resolution files

tests.CASDA: First query native TAP_SCHEMA for ivoa.obscore. Test direct STC-S s_region containment for each frozen target with native ADQL. If unsupported or null, bounded center distance <= 0.2 degrees only; never claim footprint from center.
tests.DAP: Get psrda.pulsar_obs schema and use ra_angle,dec_angle in degrees (verify by inspected unit). For each target query original files/observation rows within 0.2 deg; store whether rows are raw, calibration, search, pulsar fold, and disclose right ascension metadata semantics.
tests.matching: Pure spherical great-circle angular separation using frozen ICRS coordinate, no posthoc search changes, record all targets even no rows. No sky transforms added in R2D.
tests.control: Search archive type and data limitations; R2C2 RA-rotated footprint controls remain unchanged, no new controls tuned from test.

failure_semantics: TAP unavailable, schema incompatible, or no matching archive rows => UNKNOWN/NO_LISTED_METADATA_IN_BOUNDED_QUERY, never 'no signal' and never 'no radio observation'.
